description: Karuta Tori: a Japanese family waiting-time karuta game played with head movement only. Twenty original kami phrases (seasonal and daily life, not Hyakunin Isshu quotations) are read aloud by TTS; the player selects the matching card by turning the head left or right and confirms with a nod or Enter. Correct pick +100, wrong pick -50, 20 rounds then win/lose settlement. Best score, total cards taken and play count persist between sessions.
name: karuta-tori
